cases.name: Required sign-in fields
cases.steps: Open the sign-in page. Submit with both fields empty. Check the required-field validation.
cases.expected: Blank form stays on the sign-in page
cases.actual: True

cases.name: Unknown account rejected
cases.steps: Enter an unknown username and a password. Submit and inspect the error and dashboard visibility.
cases.expected: Error shown; no authenticated dashboard
cases.actual: Verified: Error shown; no authenticated dashboard

cases.name: Incorrect password rejected
cases.steps: Enter admin with an incorrect password. Submit and inspect the error.
cases.expected: Error shown for a valid account with wrong password
cases.actual: Verified: Error shown for a valid account with wrong password

cases.name: SQL injection input rejected
cases.steps: Enter an SQL-injection-style username and a password. Submit and check that authentication is denied.
cases.expected: Injected username does not authenticate
cases.actual: Verified: Injected username does not authenticate

cases.name: Admin username login
cases.steps: Enter admin / 123. Submit and wait for the Admin overview.
cases.expected: Admin overview loads with real metrics
cases.actual: Verified: Admin overview loads with real metrics

cases.name: Admin dashboard metrics
cases.steps: Inspect the five overview cards. Read dashboard data through the authenticated browser request and compare loaded metrics.
cases.expected: Five cards loaded with database totals including product sales
cases.actual: Five real metric cards and weekly attendance chart loaded.

cases.name: Admin mobile-number login
cases.steps: Sign in with mobile 0770000001 and password 123. Confirm the Admin workspace.
cases.expected: Mobile number and password authenticate admin
cases.actual: Verified: Mobile number and password authenticate admin

cases.name: Member search
cases.steps: Open Members. Search for an existing member name. Inspect the matching rows.
cases.expected: Matching member rows remain visible
cases.actual: Matching name: Diya Banerjee

cases.name: Search empty state
cases.steps: Search Members for a unique nonexistent string. Inspect the empty-state message.
cases.expected: Unknown search shows No matching records
cases.actual: Empty state shown for unmatched search.

cases.name: Member table pagination
cases.steps: Open Members with 10 rows per page. Select Next and inspect the page indicator and displayed range.
cases.expected: Next page changes visible rows and page indicator
cases.actual: 11–20 of 25 records

cases.name: Member required-field validation
cases.steps: Open Add member. Submit without required values. Confirm that the dialog stays open.
cases.expected: Incomplete member form cannot be submitted
cases.actual: Verified: Incomplete member form cannot be submitted

cases.name: Mobile number validation
cases.steps: Enter a three-digit mobile in Add member. Inspect the input pattern validation.
cases.expected: Three-digit mobile is rejected by the form
cases.actual: Verified: Three-digit mobile is rejected by the form

cases.name: Initial BMI preview
cases.steps: Enter height 175 cm and weight 72 kg. Read the calculated BMI preview.
cases.expected: 175 cm and 72 kg calculate BMI 23.51
cases.actual: BMI preview: 23.51

cases.name: Create member with measurements
cases.steps: Create an isolated member with a unique mobile, Monthly plan, paid flag, health notes, height 175 cm, weight 72 kg, and body fat 18%.
cases.expected: Member and initial progress are saved together
cases.actual: Created member #150

cases.name: Member initial progress persistence
cases.steps: Read Progress tracking for the created member. Verify one initial entry and BMI 23.51.
cases.expected: Initial measurement is available in Progress tracking
cases.actual: Initial measurement found with BMI 23.51.

cases.name: Duplicate member mobile blocked
cases.steps: Try to create another member with the same mobile and complete measurements. Inspect the duplicate error and count matching members.
cases.expected: Duplicate mobile rejected without duplicate records
cases.actual: Verified: Duplicate mobile rejected without duplicate records

cases.name: Edit member and retain changes
cases.steps: Edit the fixture member name and payment flag to Due. Save, refresh the browser, and search for the fixture.
cases.expected: Updated name/payment flag survive a browser refresh
cases.actual: Verified: Updated name/payment flag survive a browser refresh

cases.name: Deactivate member
cases.steps: Deactivate the fixture member. Confirm the new status and absence from active check-in choices.
cases.expected: Inactive member excluded from check-in choices
cases.actual: Verified: Inactive member excluded from check-in choices

cases.name: Reactivate member
cases.steps: Reactivate the fixture member. Confirm Active status.
cases.expected: Member status returns to Active
cases.actual: Verified: Member status returns to Active

cases.name: Record attendance with payment warning
cases.steps: Select the fixture member in Record check-in. Save and inspect the payment-due warning and attendance history.
cases.expected: One check-in saved and payment-due warning shown
cases.actual: Verified: One check-in saved and payment-due warning shown

cases.name: Duplicate attendance blocked
cases.steps: Attempt a second check-in for the same member on the same date. Inspect the validation error.
cases.expected: Second check-in on same day is rejected
cases.actual: Verified: Second check-in on same day is rejected

cases.name: Unknown member attendance rejected
cases.steps: Submit an attendance action with a nonexistent member ID through the authenticated browser. Inspect HTTP 400.
cases.expected: Tampered member ID produces HTTP 400
cases.actual: Choose an active member.

cases.name: Create trainer and login account
cases.steps: Create a unique trainer with valid profile details, hire date, username, and temporary password. Inspect the trainer and linked account.
cases.expected: Profile and Trainer account created atomically
cases.actual: Trainer and linked login created.

cases.name: Trainer username validation
cases.steps: Enter a trainer username starting with a digit. Inspect the username pattern validation.
cases.expected: Username beginning with a digit is invalid
cases.actual: Verified: Username beginning with a digit is invalid

cases.name: Create linked Member account
cases.steps: Create a Member account and link it to the fixture member. Confirm the account appears in User management.
cases.expected: Account links to the selected member profile
cases.actual: Verified: Account links to the selected member profile

cases.name: Duplicate profile link rejected
cases.steps: Attempt to link another account to the same member profile. Inspect HTTP 409 and the duplicate-link error.
cases.expected: Second account linked to same member gets HTTP 409
cases.actual: That username, mobile number, profile link, or serial number is already in use.

cases.name: Inactive account cannot log in
cases.steps: Deactivate the fixture Member account. Try to sign in with it and verify the inactive-account error.
cases.expected: Deactivated Member login is rejected
cases.actual: Verified: Deactivated Member login is rejected

cases.name: Account reactivation
cases.steps: Reactivate the fixture Member account in User management. Read the updated Active status.
cases.expected: Member account is Active after reactivation
cases.actual: Verified: Member account is Active after reactivation

cases.name: Current admin protected
cases.steps: Submit a request to deactivate the current Admin account. Inspect the self-protection error.
cases.expected: Admin cannot disable own account (HTTP 400)
cases.actual: You cannot disable your own account.

cases.name: Create equipment
cases.steps: Create equipment with a unique serial, purchase date, and warranty date. Read the new inventory row.
cases.expected: Equipment profile appears in inventory
cases.actual: Verified: Equipment profile appears in inventory

cases.name: Edit equipment condition
cases.steps: Edit the fixture equipment condition to UNDER MAINTENANCE. Save and reread its condition.
cases.expected: Condition is persisted as UNDER MAINTENANCE
cases.actual: Verified: Condition is persisted as UNDER MAINTENANCE

cases.name: Delete unreferenced equipment
cases.steps: Delete the unreferenced fixture equipment and confirm it no longer appears.
cases.expected: Created equipment is removed
cases.actual: Verified: Created equipment is removed

cases.name: Create product
cases.steps: Create a unique product with price 499.50 and stock 12. Confirm its inventory record.
cases.expected: Product price and stock saved
cases.actual: Verified: Product price and stock saved

cases.name: Negative product price validation
cases.steps: Enter -1 as the product price. Inspect the browser's minimum-value validation.
cases.expected: Negative price rejected by browser validation
cases.actual: Verified: Negative price rejected by browser validation

cases.name: Edit product price and stock
cases.steps: Edit the fixture product to price 549.75 and stock 20. Save and inspect persisted values.
cases.expected: Updated price and quantity persist
cases.actual: Verified: Updated price and quantity persist

cases.name: Referenced product deletion protected
cases.steps: Add a test-only order reference to the fixture product. Attempt deletion and inspect the protected-history error.
cases.expected: Product with order history cannot be deleted
cases.actual: Verified: Product with order history cannot be deleted

cases.name: Delete unreferenced product
cases.steps: Remove the fixture order reference. Delete the product and confirm removal.
cases.expected: Product removed after fixture history is cleared
cases.actual: Verified: Product removed after fixture history is cleared

cases.name: Negative plan price rejected
cases.steps: Submit a negative membership-plan price through the browser request. Confirm HTTP 400 without changing the price.
cases.expected: Server rejects negative price (HTTP 400)
cases.actual: Enter a nonnegative amount within the supported range.

cases.name: Workout plan details
cases.steps: Open a workout plan with View plan. Count and read all seven day sections.
cases.expected: All seven workout days are readable
cases.actual: Verified: All seven workout days are readable

cases.name: Payment history view
cases.steps: Open Payment history and inspect the loaded records.
cases.expected: Saved payment records loaded in browser
cases.actual: (None, 19)

cases.name: Product sales view
cases.steps: Open Product sales and inspect the loaded records.
cases.expected: Saved sale records loaded in browser
cases.actual: (None, 20)

cases.name: Members PDF report
cases.steps: Open Reports. Download the Members PDF. Parse it and confirm at least one page and a nonempty file.
cases.expected: Valid PDF downloaded through report button
cases.actual: 4135 bytes; 1 PDF pages.

cases.name: Trainers PDF report
cases.steps: Download the Trainers PDF through its report button. Parse and inspect the downloaded file.
cases.expected: Valid PDF downloaded through report button
cases.actual: 2308 bytes; 1 PDF pages.

cases.name: Attendance PDF report
cases.steps: Download the Attendance PDF through its report button. Parse and inspect the downloaded file.
cases.expected: Valid PDF downloaded through report button
cases.actual: 28634 bytes; 11 PDF pages.

cases.name: Payments PDF report
cases.steps: Download the Payments PDF through its report button. Parse and inspect the downloaded file.
cases.expected: Valid PDF downloaded through report button
cases.actual: 3300 bytes; 1 PDF pages.

cases.name: Sales PDF report
cases.steps: Download the Product sales PDF through its report button. Parse and inspect the downloaded file.
cases.expected: Valid PDF downloaded through report button
cases.actual: 4999 bytes; 2 PDF pages.

cases.name: Equipment PDF report
cases.steps: Download the Equipment PDF through its report button. Parse and inspect the downloaded file.
cases.expected: Valid PDF downloaded through report button
cases.actual: 4483 bytes; 2 PDF pages.

cases.name: Filtered CSV report export
cases.steps: Search Members for the fixture. Select Export CSV. Read the file and verify the matching member is included.
cases.expected: CSV download contains visible matching member
cases.actual: Filtered member CSV contains fixture row.

cases.name: Local database backup
cases.steps: Open Database backup and create a snapshot. Verify the reported SQL file exists inside the checkout's backups folder.
cases.expected: Timestamped SQL backup exists in checkout backups folder

cases.name: Trainer sign-in
cases.steps: Create an isolated training assignment and sign in as the fixture trainer. Wait for the Trainer overview.
cases.expected: Trainer account opens a separate workspace
cases.actual: Verified: Trainer account opens a separate workspace

cases.name: Trainer navigation restriction
cases.steps: Inspect Trainer navigation. Confirm Assigned members exists and User management does not.
cases.expected: Admin management links are absent
cases.actual: Trainer navigation excludes admin modules.

cases.name: Trainer server authorization
cases.steps: Request the admin Members endpoint from a Trainer session. Inspect HTTP 403.
cases.expected: Direct members API denied with HTTP 403
cases.actual: Administrator access required.

cases.name: Trainer assigned-member list
cases.steps: Open Assigned members. Confirm the fixture member name and ID appear.
cases.expected: Trainer sees their assigned member
cases.actual: Assigned fixture member and ID displayed.

cases.name: Trainer progress entry
cases.steps: Record progress for the assigned member: height 175 cm, weight 71 kg, body fat 17%, current date. Inspect BMI 23.18.
cases.expected: Assigned member progress saved with calculated BMI 23.18
cases.actual: Verified: Assigned member progress saved with calculated BMI 23.18

cases.name: Future progress date rejected
cases.steps: Submit a future-dated measurement through the browser request. Inspect HTTP 400.
cases.expected: Server rejects a future measurement date (HTTP 400)
cases.actual: Date cannot be in the future.

cases.name: Unassigned member progress denied
cases.steps: Attempt progress entry for an unrelated member ID. Inspect HTTP 403.
cases.expected: Trainer cannot write progress for an unrelated member
cases.actual: Member is not actively assigned to you.

cases.name: Trainer edits own profile
cases.steps: Open the Trainer profile. Edit the fixture trainer name. Save and inspect the profile and account display.
cases.expected: Profile and account display name update together
cases.actual: Verified: Profile and account display name update together

cases.name: Wrong current password rejected
cases.steps: Attempt a password change with an incorrect current password. Inspect the error.
cases.expected: Password is preserved when current password is wrong
cases.actual: Verified: Password is preserved when current password is wrong

cases.name: Password confirmation validation
cases.steps: Enter different new and confirmation passwords. Submit and inspect the mismatch error.
cases.expected: Mismatched new passwords cannot be saved
cases.actual: Verified: Mismatched new passwords cannot be saved

cases.name: Trainer password change
cases.steps: Change the fixture trainer password with matching confirmation. Verify that the old password fails and the new password authenticates.
cases.expected: Old password rejected and new password works
cases.actual: Verified: Old password rejected and new password works

cases.name: Member sign-in
cases.steps: Sign in with the linked fixture Member account. Wait for the Member overview.
cases.expected: Linked Member account opens member workspace
cases.actual: Verified: Linked Member account opens member workspace

cases.name: Member own membership view
cases.steps: Open My profile. Confirm the member's own name, Monthly plan, and payment status.
cases.expected: Member sees own profile, plan, and payment status
cases.actual: Verified: Member sees own profile, plan, and payment status

cases.name: Member attendance scoped
cases.steps: Open My attendance. Verify only the fixture member's one check-in is returned.
cases.expected: Only fixture member check-in is returned
cases.actual: Verified: Only fixture member check-in is returned

cases.name: Member progress scoped and read-only
cases.steps: Open My progress. Verify the initial and trainer-entered measurements; confirm no add-record action exists.
cases.expected: Own initial/trainer entries visible; no record action
cases.actual: Verified: Own initial/trainer entries visible; no record action

cases.name: Member training scoped
cases.steps: Open My training. Confirm only the fixture member's assigned trainer and training record are shown.
cases.expected: Only own training assignment is visible
cases.actual: Verified: Only own training assignment is visible

cases.name: Member admin API access denied
cases.steps: Request User management data from the Member browser session. Inspect HTTP 403.
cases.expected: User management API denied with HTTP 403
cases.actual: Administrator access required.

cases.name: Member progress write denied
cases.steps: Attempt a Trainer progress action from the Member session. Inspect HTTP 403.
cases.expected: Member cannot submit trainer progress action
cases.actual: Trainer access required.

cases.name: Member edits own profile
cases.steps: Edit the fixture member's own name. Save and inspect the updated profile.
cases.expected: Own name updates in profile and account
cases.actual: Verified: Own name updates in profile and account

cases.name: Desktop layout
cases.steps: Set a desktop browser window to 1440 pixels wide. Inspect the profile and check document horizontal overflow.
cases.expected: Document has no horizontal overflow at 1440px
cases.actual: Verified: Document has no horizontal overflow at 1440px

cases.name: Mobile navigation and layout
cases.steps: Emulate a true 390 by 844 mobile viewport. Open the navigation drawer, select Progress, wait for the transition, and inspect overflow.
cases.expected: 390px navigation works without document overflow
cases.actual: Verified: 390px navigation works without document overflow

cases.name: Theme persistence
cases.steps: Toggle dark theme, refresh the page, and confirm the theme persists. Capture the rendered screen.
cases.expected: Dark theme remains selected after page refresh
cases.actual: Verified: Dark theme remains selected after page refresh

cases.name: Sign-out invalidates browser session
cases.steps: Sign out using the confirmation dialog. Confirm the login page and HTTP 401 from the protected account endpoint.
cases.expected: Protected API requires sign-in after logout
cases.actual: Verified: Protected API requires sign-in after logout

cases.name: Anonymous report access denied
cases.steps: Request a PDF report without an authenticated session. Inspect HTTP 401.
cases.expected: Report endpoint returns HTTP 401
cases.actual: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

cases.name: Server source is not publicly served
cases.steps: Request GymWebServer.java through the browser URL. Confirm HTTP 404.
cases.expected: Source file URL returns HTTP 404
cases.actual: Java source URL returned 404.

cases.name: Admin account password reset
cases.steps: As Admin, reset the fixture Member password. Verify the old password fails and the reset password works.
cases.expected: Reset password works; old password no longer works
cases.actual: Verified: Reset password works; old password no longer works

cases.name: Delete member and linked account
cases.steps: Delete the fixture member. Verify the profile, linked login, attendance, progress, and assignment are removed and sign-in fails.
cases.expected: Member deletion cascades fixture history and login
cases.actual: Verified: Member deletion cascades fixture history and login

cases.name: Delete unreferenced trainer
cases.steps: Delete the now-unreferenced fixture trainer. Confirm profile and linked account removal.
cases.expected: Trainer and linked account removed after assignment cleanup
cases.actual: Verified: Trainer and linked account removed after assignment cleanup

cases.name: Module summary values
cases.steps: Compare the Members summary card count with the current authenticated Members response.
cases.expected: Member summary count equals loaded database rows
cases.actual: Module summary matches the actual member record count.

cases.name: Membership plan price update
cases.steps: Create a test-only membership plan. Edit its price from 17.50 to 29.75 in the UI, reread the value, then remove that exact fixture plan.
cases.expected: A valid price change is persisted for an isolated plan
cases.actual: Fixture plan price changed from 17.50 to 29.75.
